description: This file manages custom field mappings for leads in the vtiger CRM system, including functions to retrieve and process custom fields and their mappings across various modules.

methods.name: customFieldMappings
methods.description: Retrieves mappings of custom fields for leads, returning an array of field information including display and editability status.

methods.name: getModuleValues
methods.description: Fetches module-specific fields and their details, filtering out fields not considered relevant for mapping.
